tuples.subject: apr_disclosure
tuples.quote: The HFCs shall give notice to the borrower in the vernacular language or a language as understood by the borrower of any change in the terms and conditions including disbursement schedule, interest rates, penal charges (if any), service charges, prepayment charges, other applicable fee/ charges etc.

tuples.subject: apr_disclosure
tuples.quote: HFCs should also ensure that changes in interest rates and charges are effected only prospectively.
